<!-- main-pr583-approved-pr465-integration-20260918 -->
#583's historical audit preservation is independently approved at
`2168cc4b3b8a455619b7b3f6bc77686d32c8e3d0` by
[review 5242315909](https://github.com/Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-A/pull/583#pullrequestreview-5242315909).
MAIN verified the actual head, body, marker, final verdict, zero findings,
publisher and all nine CI contexts, then posted and read back summary success.
The head is stale, so this does not move it ahead of #465. Original #545's
retirement still awaits integration; issue #513's disposition is separate.

The fresh Sol/Ultra reviewer checked the full one-file patch, valid metadata,
historical qualifications, citations and exact original 172-line body.
Document-only CI skips were not counted as new Lean builds. Five artifact
hashes and the clean review worktree were verified. Feynman
`01a0b19f-3cf5-7440-9344-4b8181d601d6` ran from 23:06:38.265Z to
23:13:25.333Z: 407.068 seconds, including a 47.068-second budget overrun.
Actual task delta: 2830016 input, 2719232 cached input, 15495 output,
4782 reasoning tokens. The thread is retired and its claim released;
admission, publication and terminal evidence are archived in
`results/telemetry/native-reviews/pr583-2168cc4b-01a0b19f/`.

#465's updater is confirmed running its guarded publication/build checks
under PID1319682. MAIN has not restarted it or started a competing publisher.
The preparatory strict comparison against approved `a72c8dbb` fails for
candidate `287ddbc2`: two main-derived context lines differ, while every
added/removed line is unchanged. Published review policy section13 still
precludes automatic carry. The helper queue now requests a fresh bounded
integration recheck after final-head CI, rooted audit and updater release,
preserving the four full reviews and terminal F1-F8 resolutions. No fifth
whole-proof review or budget reset is authorized.

The source-unitary packet is published as #584 at `22b612ef`; a fresh Opus
reviewer claimed it at 23:05:44Z. Its source-domain/error-scale/conditional
marker review remains pending. No competing native review was started.
One helper publication row was folded with exact-record deduplication;
the 54-row spool remains append-only.

The required cycle snapshot completed. The previous cycle was progress
(#481 merged, #547 preservation completed); this cycle completes #583's
independent review and determines #465's required integration gate.
Caps remain 0/0/0, no lanes or open native threads, only daemon merges,
no #168 post. The formalization goal remains active.

<!-- main-pr465-gates-pr584-finding-pr534-admission-20260918 -->
#465 is published at `287ddbc22950a2db5bebc14b30e03e8d1e95e236`.
The updater released it at 23:27:29Z. MAIN verified all nine CI contexts
(303 seconds) and the required rooted audit: 1656 pass, 0 fail,
3 statement-only warnings, no proof-level dependency on sorryAx.
Publication/gate evidence is archived in
`results/telemetry/native-audits/pr465-update-20260918/`.

The next gate is a fresh bounded integration review, now queued for Opus.
Every added/removed line matches the approved patch, but two context lines
changed, so published review policy section13 does not permit automatic
carry. The updater's carry suggestion is not adopted. The four full reviews
and terminal F1-F8 assessment remain counted; no fifth whole-proof review
or renewed mathematical attempt is requested. No further passive refresh is needed.

#584 received independent review5242362996 on `22b612ef`:
code APPROVED, prose CHANGES_REQUESTED, one finding. MAIN checked the actual
head/marker/verdict/publisher/unchecked finding and posted/read back review
failure. F1 concerns the certified unitary proof's retained detailed argument
and omitted blueprint dependencies. A fresh helper is requested to make the
narrow composition-proof prose repair, then obtain an independent recheck.
Lean producers, the displayed nested scale and retained conditional markers
are unchanged. The printed-error absorption is still unformalized; this
review does not certify it or final soundness. The MAIN gate claim is released.

The sole native is fresh Sol/Ultra Ptolemy
`01a0b1ad-8f1a-7161-96b8-bc2e6a6df9a1`, preserving the remaining #534
point-consistency/restoration API and historical evidence on NEW
`issue-515-preserve-point-consistency-20260918`, base `5080d852`.
It first checks semantic equivalents, reuses the restriction/resampling
results already merged from #467/#456, and preserves only missing content.
Original #534, issue #515, source completion markers and error definitions
remain untouched. No full build or CI competes with the merge queue.
Actual start23:22:16.833Z; deadline23:37:16.833Z, 900 seconds with final180s
reserved for validation/commit/receipt. Admission contains actual task delta,
model/effort, rollout, brief and source input in
`results/telemetry/native-audits/pr534-preservation-01a0b1ad/`.
Existing attempt and cost history is retained without a budget reset.

The cycle snapshot completed. Two helper rows were folded by exact-record
deduplication, leaving the 56-row spool append-only. The existing #536
preservation packet is queued for publication only, after ready merge gates.
The previous cycle was progress (#583 review completed); this cycle records
#465's green gates, routes #584's finding and admits the bounded preservation.
Caps0/0/0, one native, no lanes, only daemon merges, no #168 post. Goal active.
